extraction_notes: Source PDF C347499__AO3416A.pdf, SHA-256 94e8691bfc11c51343eee778727a3e686334c33996cc32d86f960774b3ba7ba9, verified before extraction.

Datasheet carries no explicit revision code; the footer date Nov.2024 (UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited, www.umw-ic.com) is used as the revision identifier. UMW is the brand of UTD Semiconductor; target manufacturer identity preserved as briefed.

Method: page images read at full page resolution and digitized manually; no vendor SPICE or model pack consulted. Curve reads carry roughly half-minor-division uncertainty (transfer/output about +/-1 A, capacitance about +/-25 pF, RDS(on) about +/-1 mohm, VSD about +/-0.02 V).

Capacitance and body-diode curves are anchored to the page-2 typical table values at their stated bias (Ciss 1295 pF, Coss 160 pF, Crss 87 pF at VDS = 10 V; VSD 0.62 V at IS = 1 A), which pins the absolute scale of those digitizations.

Transfer-curve read is cross-consistent with the table forward transconductance gFS typ 50 S at VDS = 5 V, ID = 6.5 A (p. 2): the digitized 25 degC curve slope between VGS = 1.4 V and 1.5 V is about 50 A/V.

Figure 1 output family: only the VGS = 1.5 V and 1.8 V traces saturate inside the plotted 0-30 A window; the 2.5 V, 3.1 V and 4.5 V traces exit through the plot top while still quasi-ohmic, so no reliable saturation points exist for them and they were not digitized.

Gate Threshold Voltage publishes MIN 0.4 V and MAX 1.1 V only; no TYP column value, hence threshold_typ is null. The typical transfer curve implies an effective typical threshold near 1.0-1.1 V at VDS = 5 V.

All three RDS(ON) table rows are MAX-only (25 mohm at 4.5 V/6.5 A, 33 mohm at 2.5 V/5.5 A, 51 mohm at 1.8 V/5 A); typical on-resistance points were additionally digitized from Figure 3 at the matching ID for each VGS.

Auxiliary table facts for fitting (p. 2, all typical unless noted): ID(ON) >= 30 A min at VDS = 5 V, VGS = 4.5 V; IDSS max 1 uA at VDS = 20 V; Qg 10 nC, Qgs 4.2 nC, Qgd 2.6 nC at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 10 V, ID = 6.5 A; trr 31 ns typ / 41 ns max and Qrr 6.8 nC at IF = 6.5 A, dI/dt = 100 A/us; IS max 2 A continuous. Thermal (p. 1): RthJA 90 degC/W (t <= 10 s) / 125 degC/W steady state, RthJF 80 degC/W. Absolute max: VDS 20 V, VGS +/-8 V, ID 6.5 A at TA = 25 degC.

Gate resistance row prints Rg = 1.8 KOhm (VGS = 0 V, VDS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz). The KOhm unit is suspect (typical trench-FET Rg is about 1.8 ohm); transcribed verbatim here and flagged rather than silently corrected.
Units: spec values converted to base SI (F, ohm, V, A); curve axes preserve the datasheet axis units (pF, mohm, nC) as printed.
